title: Domains and naturality predicates for open coefficient squares
statement: Fix normalized operations and finite typed words. Structural selects tensor constraints, pullback and proper-image composition, and proper/open adjunction units and counits. OpenGenerator selects beta, open projection, lambda and Gamma; OpenIsomorphism omits Gamma. InverseAssertion is the coefficient square for the specified inverse maps. Input actions recurse functorially in all word slots; SquareNaturality asserts naturality of both vertical and horizontal arrows. StructuralSquares quantifies the structural coefficient square over every finite-type family and admissible intermediate word, with no word-length restriction. These are precisely the eight existing definitions extracted unchanged from OpenInterchangeReductionSquares. The normalized operation models are those of [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge] and the typed-word domain is that of [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain]; the operation data, finite words, generator kinds, admissibility predicates and the coefficient-square Assertion are those of [def-sf-generator-reduction-data].
